name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd.
business_summary: Largest private general insurer in India by gross premium (motor ~35-40%, health ~25-30%, property/fire/marine/commercial/crop remainder; model estimate), 51.3% owned by ICICI Bank. Q2 FY27 profit rose 15.5% to Rs946cr in some reports and 27.5% to Rs1,031cr in others (conflicting headlines; unresolved), with investment income and treasury gains offsetting an elevated combined ratio. Rs7 interim dividend declared. Stock Rs1,622, -20.5% in 12 months, 51% promoter, FII holding down to 18.3% from 22.3%.

exposures.mechanism: IRDAI's 2026-09-23 exposure draft on commission caps/dark patterns hits distribution-intensive insurers: ICICIGI pays ~15-17% of GWP as commission (model estimate); a cap lowers payout -> brokers/agents/banks (bancassurance ICICI Bank is a big partner) shift to uncapped products. Impact: GWP -2% in the near term but expense ratio -1pp (PAT +) if cap binds on insurers' payout => net value -4 central, wide range because motor/health caps differ from life caps. Systematix: IRDAI may revisit (BT 2026-09-25).

evidence.note: IRDAI commission-cap proposal and dark-pattern ban; sector sell-off

exposures.mechanism: Motor is ~35-40% of GWP (model estimate): +10% vehicle volumes -> new-vehicle OD/TP premium +4-5% -> GWP +1.7%, incremental PAT +2.5% (growth is margin-accretive on OD) x persistence 0.5 => +1.2. GST cuts of Sept 2025 pulled demand forward.

Pack empirical -2.11 (t=-1.6) agrees; INR 94.49 (+6.5% y/y).

Investment income was the offset to underwriting pressure in Q2 (treasury gains).
